queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'SuperCollider Version %' AND publisher = 'SuperCollider Community';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'SuperCollider Version %' AND publisher = 'SuperCollider Community' AND version_compare(version, '3.14.1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('scide.exe','sclang.exe','scsynth.exe','supernova.exe'));
